claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve and a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee, totaling 540,750 ADA.
The requested funding would support a part-time UTxO RPC maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
UTxO RPC is an open interface specification using Protocol Buffers with SDKs in Rust, Go, Node.js, .NET, Haskell, and Python.
The proposal says UTxO RPC has been adopted by Amaru, Dingo, and the Haskell Cardano node as a query interface.
The project maintains more than 10 repositories covering the core specification, SDKs, documentation, and provider integrations, and is open-source under Apache 2.0.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposer states the withdrawal does not breach the 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.
TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.
The 2026 treasury management process will use Sundae Labs smart contracts, Intersect admin and leadership roles, an external six-entity Oversight Committee, and milestone-based disbursement controls.
A public dashboard and on-chain smart contract addresses are provided for community audit and tracking of the withdrawn ADA.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for 12 months of UTxO RPC maintenance by TxPipe through Intersect-administered treasury smart contracts, with claims of ecosystem adoption, prior delivery history, Intersect voting approval, NCL compliance, and oversight controls.
